meta_title: BlueCart Alternative for Food Distributors in 2026
meta_desc: Keep the BlueCart listing that finds new kitchens, and give your regulars a reorder they speak into an app. A BlueCart alternative that removes nothing.
text: Saved on each order that skips the phone
Is how long go-live takes for most distributors
Is when most kitchens place their first order
When an alternative to BlueCart starts to look tempting

BlueCart sells reach: it helps you find new customers. You join their marketplace, get listed in what they call the "endless aisle", and restaurants across their network can see you. That is worth keeping for a supplier chasing new accounts. Once an account is yours, though, the weekly reorder is a different job, and that is usually when a BlueCart competitor gets a look.
The reorder still comes by phone
Plenty of accounts never order online at all. They call at seven in the morning or after close, and someone at your end writes each order up.
Online ordering helps the ones who log in
BlueCart presents its Order Management Solution as a replacement for phone and email ordering. For buyers who use it, it does replace them. The kitchens who prefer talking to logging in are the gap.
Leaving would cost you new customers

Coming off the marketplace would give up the new kitchens it brings in, and the regulars on the phone would still be on the phone. That is why a BlueCart alternative that takes the listing down is the wrong fix here.
The BlueCart alternative that leaves your listing up

Your account holds the button and says what the kitchen needs. Items appear as lines with quantities, they fix anything wrong, and they send. Each item comes from their own guide, and they check every line before it goes.
Your customer looks at the list before anything leaves
Done in the cooler or at the desk, at any hour
Saves 20 to 30 minutes compared with the same order by phone
Interrupted halfway? It holds the order until they come back
Your products, at your own prices
You send the guides you keep per customer. We load them with your SKUs and the price you set for that account.
A kitchen sees nothing but the lines it buys
Pricing and the catalog remain yours to set
Change a guide once and every later order uses it
Every item maps to a SKU you already use
It turns up the way your desk expects
A finished order leaves as an email carrying a PDF, Excel or Word file, or goes straight into your ERP over the API, over EDI, or into QuickBooks, in a shape your desk opens daily.
Addressed to a rep, or to the purchasing desk
Over EDI, the API or QuickBooks, nobody on your team retypes it
Picking, billing and delivery carry on unchanged
You do not have to remove any software first
Stock in view as each order lands

VoiceOrder Solutions carries real-time inventory visibility tied to what is being ordered, and the catalog updates as stock levels change. It does not replace your stock system: that stays in charge, and a demo shows how the levels connect.
Every line you carry, not only the quick movers
Fewer stockout surprises on a late, heavy order
Stock numbers come from the system you count with today
Nothing gets counted in our app
BlueCart finds the account, voice adds a quicker reorder
VoiceOrder Solutions is not a BlueCart replacement, because it cannot do the thing BlueCart is for. It adds on, so you can use it and stay listed on the marketplace.
Meet them on BlueCart, make reordering quick

A marketplace is a good way to meet an account you had no route to. Once they buy from you regularly, some will want a quicker way to reorder than logging in, and our app gives them one while the listing keeps working.
Let each account order the way it likes
Kitchens happy ordering through BlueCart can keep doing it. Regulars who would still rather call get an app that turns what they say into a list they check.
Our orders land where you choose
Ours show up in whichever system you picked, by EDI, through the API or in QuickBooks, or as an email to your desk. Nothing about your BlueCart dashboard changes.
See a regular's reorder go from voice to your desk
Twenty minutes. One account, a single spoken order from a sample guide, signed off before it sends.
Three steps, and no listing to build
There is nothing new to put on the marketplace, and your BlueCart listing stays as it is. You send guides, we set up accounts, your kitchens start ordering.
Whatever format they are already in. Each account's lines and your prices go into a single admin screen, lined up with your codes.
Accounts are created for each kitchen, which then downloads our app. Most have ordered before that day ends.
Approved by the customer, with an order number and the time it was sent, in the format your system expects.
Find accounts there, take reorders here.

Adding our app should not cost you anything you already have, and every row below reflects that. BlueCart's own pitch is a marketplace that puts you in front of restaurants you have never sold to, and a BlueCart alternative search is usually about repeat orders from regulars, not about finding new ones. The two do not connect, and what we say about BlueCart was read on their site.
Reaching restaurants you do not supply yet
Accounts speak the reorder into an app
Orders keep their place if a cook is called away
Your customer signs off the order before it sends
Promotions and offers for repeat business
A rep app and a wholesale CRM
Per-account ordering lists at the prices you set
An order dashboard to confirm and track orders
What distributors on BlueCart ask us
Is a BlueCart alternative the only way to add spoken orders?

No, and the listing never has to come down. VoiceOrder Solutions adds an app where the accounts on your books say what they need and approve it, while BlueCart goes on bringing in kitchens that are new to you. Nothing gets turned off.
Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than BlueCart?

At finding new customers, no, and it is not a close call. That is what BlueCart sells, and we offer nothing like it. We help with the repeat order from an account already on your books: only your products, at your prices, approved by your customer. People who search for a BlueCart alternative often want help with repeat orders, not a way to stop meeting new kitchens.
Are VoiceOrder Solutions and BlueCart connected?

No. The two products are not linked, and neither supports the other. Each delivers its orders into your own system independently, ours as an email with a file attached, over EDI or the API, or into QuickBooks.
Won't our accounts be ordering in two places?

Some may, and that can be fine. A kitchen you met on the marketplace can keep buying there. Offer our app to the regulars who still call your desk, since a spoken reorder from your own guide is where it saves the most time. Calls you go on taking get no order number from us; that only comes with orders sent through the app.
How do our prices appear in your app?
Each account sees its own guide, priced the way you set it. BlueCart's Pricing Insights, which labels products as great, good or fair value, carries on for your marketplace listing.
How fast can accounts begin ordering?

For most distributors this is live inside 24 to 48 hours, with a first order usually in on the same day. BlueCart says theirs can be live within days too, and since the listing stays up, there is nothing to schedule around.
Neither of us publishes a figure. Theirs follows a demo; ours comes as a quote once we have talked. With the listing kept, the only new cost is the voice reorder, and a quote shows what that is.
Where do the BlueCart details on this page come from?

Everything here came from bluecart.com, read 10 October 2026: the marketplace positioning off the headline, the Pricing Insights and endless aisle descriptions off their product list, and the setup line off their FAQ. We have left their transaction and funding figures alone, because those are theirs. If something there is out of date now, we will fix it.
